steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Boolean operations: work on Boolean values (TRUE and FALSE) to produce a Boolean result. They are used to combine or invert conditions in IF statements and WHILE loops. | NOT: reverses a Boolean value. NOT TRUE = FALSE, NOT FALSE = TRUE. It is used to invert a condition. | AND: returns TRUE only when BOTH conditions are TRUE. If either one is FALSE, the result is FALSE. | OR: returns TRUE when at least ONE condition is TRUE. Only returns FALSE when BOTH conditions are FALSE.
